source_references.role: edit target; previous selected v2 atlas, retained unchanged
user-provided Reston hair reference; not copied into the project asset tree

provenance.processing: Direct tool output copied to atlas.png; no manual hair painting or compositing. Native pipeline only isolates/scales/quantizes.

prompt_text:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: existing original cartoon SNES fighting-game 4x4 transparent character atlas.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact existing Reston sprite atlas EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the user's new Reston photograph, HAIR REFERENCE ONLY.
Primary request: Reston is too bald. Change only his hair in all sixteen poses to resemble Image 2: very short dark near-black buzz-cut hair across the crown AND top, a high but moderately receding front hairline, dense cropped sides, some fine thinning on the upper/front scalp. He has close-cropped hair, not a bare shiny bald crown. Give him a restrained continuous dark cropped hair cap extending further forward over the scalp than the edit target; retain his naturally high forehead. At the tiny native sprite scale the top hair should read as dark charcoal/near-black, with a few lighter scalp/short-hair highlights, not a large bare orange forehead-to-crown dome. Do not give him long hair, a pompadour, bangs or a full low youthful hairline. The edit is modest and reference-faithful, not a new hairstyle.
Invariants: keep the exact 1254x1254 transparent canvas, 4 columns by 4 rows, all sixteen full-body figures, exact pose positions, body anatomy and proportions, existing heads/face identity and beard, orange/copper jacket and cream cuffs/collar, navy trousers and shoes, material colors, navy outlines, crisp original 1993 arcade cartoon cel shading, right-facing orientation, pose order and baselines. Only the scalp hair changes. Keep generous fully transparent gaps between every figure, including hands/feet. Never merge adjacent poses. Preserve the KO pose head-left feet-right at row4 column3. Preserve all silhouettes and actions. No background, grid, shadows, labels, text, watermark, energy effects or detached parts.
Pose order unchanged: idle, walk-forward, walk-back, crouch; jump, jab, cross, kick; sweep, block, hurt, victory; cast, uppercut, horizontal knockout, rush.
Output: same transparent RGBA 1254x1254 production atlas. Change only Reston's hair consistently across all sixteen poses.
